_comment: Recorded budgets for a STOCK build of build/core/dos_core.elf. Checked by scripts/budget_gate.py; write with --update. RAISING A NUMBER HERE IS THE REVIEW -- the commit that raises it must say what grew and why. See scripts/common/budgets.py for what each one means and what the frame count is and is not.
_measured: 2026-09-02 on agent/sb-adpcm, stock flags, forced re-link. RAM raised 604395336 -> 604396184 (+848 B) by the Creative ADPCM decoder in x86_io.c: 240 B of const step/adjust tables plus ~608 B of code. THE CORE IS A FLAT BLOB IN RAM_EMU -- dos_core.ld puts .text AND .rodata there -- so there is no flash to move the tables to. Nothing entered .bss beyond 8 bytes of decoder state in the static sbp struct, ITCM did NOT move (0xF108 either side), and the frame bound stayed at 154. Prior note: 2026-09-02 on agent/opcodes-bits, stock flags, forced re-link. ITCM raised 59696 -> 61704 (+2008 B) by the 0F bit and double-shift set: BT/BTS/BTR/BTC (A3/AB/B3/BB), BSF/BSR (BC/BD) and SHLD/SHRD (A4/A5/AC/AD), ten opcodes emitted TWICE (one pass per operand size). RAM and the frame bound did NOT move -- none of it touches .bss.
